title: Light in Room Nine  (Luce nella camera nove)

segments.t: Nella veranda della camera nove, Graham avvolge l'ultima giunzione con il rotolo nuovo di nastro isolante nero mentre Hannah tiene ferma la scala e Caleb controlla la placca a muro. Ascolta prima tutta la scena.
Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Hannah.
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Hannah?
Should we call Arthur to flip the switch?
Not a chance. Your turn, Hannah, one clean click.
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
Listen to the kitchen too: no pop, and the oven is still humming.
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
Wait, look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Hannah!
Ripercorriamo ora la scena passo dopo passo.
Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Hannah.
'Passami le piccole viti d'ottone dalla tua tasca, Hannah.'
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
'Una, due. Il nuovo cavo di rame è collegato fino alla scatola?'
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
'Cavo nuovo di zecca, fusibile in porcellana nuovo e zero vecchio tessuto rimasto nel muro.'
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
'La placca d'ottone dell'interruttore poggia dritta e ben salda contro i mattoni.'
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Hannah?
'Scendi e allontanati dalla scala. Pronta a provarlo come si deve, Hannah?'
Should we call Arthur to flip the switch?
'Dovremmo chiamare Arthur per premere l'interruttore?'
Not a chance. Your turn, Hannah, one clean click.
'Nemmeno per sogno. Tocca a te, Hannah, un clic pulito.'
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
'Ci siamo... clic! Oh, guardate che calda luce dorata!'
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
'Il paralume in vetro satinato diffonde una luce morbida su ogni vetro della finestra!'
Listen to the kitchen too: no pop, and the oven is still humming.
'Ascoltate anche la cucina: nessun botto, e il forno continua a ronzare.'
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
'La camera nove ha ufficialmente la luce dopo trent'anni al buio!'
Wait, look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Hannah!
'Aspetta, guarda quell'ombra dentro il coperchio aperto del pianoforte, Hannah!'
Riascoltiamo tutta la scena di fila.
Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Hannah.
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Hannah?
Should we call Arthur to flip the switch?
Not a chance. Your turn, Hannah, one clean click.
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
Listen to the kitchen too: no pop, and the oven is still humming.
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
Wait, look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Hannah!
Il lampadario in vetro satinato diffonde una luce dorata senza far saltare alcun fusibile, e il suo chiarore rivela all'improvviso un'ombra sotto il coperchio del pianoforte. A tra pochissimo.
See you soon!
